agents.name: Supply Chain Agent
agents.description: Connect dependency and runtime inventory to authoritative advisories and package-compromise alerts.
agents.permission: Read inventory and approved feeds. Cannot edit application code or run attacks.

agents.name: Remediation Agent
agents.description: Prepare a scoped code patch or supported fixed dependency/runtime update, then hand it back for independent checks.
agents.permission: Write only to a disposable branch. Cannot change frozen verifier tests or merge.

agents.name: Development Security Agent
agents.description: Watch local change events, inspect application logic, and run scoped security checks and legitimate-use regressions.
inputs: Candidate code and frozen test pack
outputs: Evidence linked to code and tests
agents.permission: Run bounded checks in an isolated, owned environment. Cannot edit the candidate or target production.
